name: SentWebAppMessage
description: Describes an inline message sent by a [Web App](https://core.telegram.org/bots/webapps) on behalf of a user.

fields.name: inline_message_id
fields.description: Identifier of the sent inline message. Available only if there is an [inline keyboard](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inlinekeyboardmarkup) attached to the message.
